name: csv quoting embedded newlines and default string values are preserved
input: quoted commas embedded newline and numeric-looking text
test:
text = 'name,note,score
Ada,"hello, world",07
Lin,"two
lines",
'
assert parse_csv_records(text, required_columns=('name', 'note')) == [
    {'name': 'Ada', 'note': 'hello, world', 'score': '07'},
    {'name': 'Lin', 'note': 'two
lines', 'score': ''},
]

name: converters are explicit and limited to named columns
input: one numeric converter while another numeric-looking field remains text
test:
rows = parse_csv_records('id,score,code\na,7,008\n', converters={'score': int})
assert rows == [{'id': 'a', 'score': 7, 'code': '008'}]
try:
    parse_csv_records('id,score\na,nope\n', converters={'score': int})
    raise AssertionError('expected ValueError')
except ValueError:
    pass
